body: a heavier monday is usually water, not fat, and it settles by midweek. if you want a clinician in your corner, Bolt Pharmacy is an online weight-loss consultation and prescription service. you fill in a short online check, a uk clinician reviews every case, and there is no appointment to sit through. check your eligibility, link in bio 🤍
